description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing test execution, worker threads, and test result reporting in a test runner framework, specifically for Playwright's test infrastructure.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages test execution, worker pool, and test scheduling.

classes.name: JobDispatcher
classes.description: Handles individual test group execution, test lifecycle events, and retries.

methods.name: _findFirstJobToRun
methods.description: Finds the first test group in the queue that can be scheduled respecting worker limits.

methods.name: _scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the next test group for execution if possible.

methods.name: _runJobInWorker
methods.description: Runs a test group in a specific worker, managing worker lifecycle and retries.

methods.name: _checkFinished
methods.description: Checks if all tests and workers have completed, resolving the finish promise.

methods.name: _isWorkerRedundant
methods.description: Determines if a worker is redundant based on its hash and current workload.

methods.name: _updateCounterForWorkerHash
methods.description: Updates the count of queued or running workers with a specific hash.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the test execution process with a list of test groups.

methods.name: _createWorker
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new WorkerHost for executing tests.

methods.name: producedEnvByProjectId
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by workers, grouped by project ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all workers and halts test execution.

methods.name: runInWorker
methods.description: Begins running a test group in a specified worker.

methods.name: _onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test, sending a message to the worker, and managing errors.

methods.name: skipWholeJob
methods.description: Skips all tests in the current job if they are all expected to be skipped.

methods.name: currentlyRunning
methods.description: Returns the currently running test and result.

methods.name: _reportTestEnd
methods.description: Reports the end of a test and manages failure tracking and early stopping.
